verdict.rationale: Some terminal emulators ship built-in AI features, so this axis applies to kitty. Nothing in the evidence shows kitty generating AI insights or suggestions itself. The documented and hands-on-verified remote-control interface (kitten @ ls/send-text/get-text) only lets an external agent drive the terminal. That is a developer building block, not an in-product AI capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
